profile.headline: Senior Software Developer/Senior ETL Developer role #Snowflake #ETL #SQL #Datawarehouse #Informatica #IDMC
profile.summary:
• Results-driven Senior ETL Developer with 10 years of experience designing, developing, and implementing ETL solutions for complex data integration projects
• Skilled in multiple ETL tools like Informatica and Alteryx, with a proven track record of delivering successful projects on time and within budget
• Proficient in Informatica PowerCenter, with expertise in ETL processes, Adept in integrating various data sources, ensuring data quality and accuracy, and optimizing performance
• Skilled in SQL, Unix Shell scripting, and various Oracle databases
• Utilized Informatica Designer to create complex mappings and mapplets, and designed transformation logic to facilitate data integration
• Extensively used different Informatica transformations like Filter, Aggregator, Sequence Generator, Connected and Unconnected Lookup, Router, Update Strategy and Normalizer
• Possess experience in managing slowly changing dimensions (SCD) type 1 and 2 in ETL.
• Extensive experience in Performance Tuning in Informatica & Oracle
• Skilled in creating DB objects like stored procedures, packages, functions, triggers and views
• experience in writing SQL queries against Snowflake, a cloud-based data warehousing platform.
• Have hands-on experience working with various Snowflake utilities, including SnowSQL, SnowPipe, Tasks, Streams, Time travel, data sharing, and Data cloning task.
• experience with Snowflake database for one-time data migration from SQL Server to Snowflake, and created a data pipeline using SnowSQL and Python
• Proficient in data modeling, data analysis, design, and development for data warehousing, including  OLTP, OLAP, dimensions, facts, and data modeling. 
• Have a strong understanding of Star schema and Snowflake schema.
• Created Physical, Logical and Conceptual data model using ER and EER diagrams.
• Have a good knowledge in software development life cycle methodologies, including design and development, testing, and documentation of the entire life cycle.
• Worked in both Waterfall and Agile software development methodologies.
• Experienced in troubleshooting Data Quality Issues, ETL Job failures and backfills process.
• Experience working in requirements, architecture, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance of different enterprise level end-to-end projects.
• Experienced in working in a dynamic and high-pressure environment.
• Ability to managing multiple tasks simultaneously while ensuring timely completion.
• A team player with excellent communication and problem-solving skills, dedicated to achieving high quality results.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer /  Senior ETL Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked on a healthcare cost reduction initiative aimed at identifying high-cost members driving 30% of total health expenditure due to multiple chronic conditions and heavy prescription usage, projected to deliver $17M in annual savings by proactively managing high-risk members through personalized health coaching and wellness interventions. 
•	Designed IDMC Advanced workflows using Mapping Designer, Dynamic Mappings and Pushdown Optimization to extract, transform, and load 42 months of eligibility, medical and Rx claims data from Snowflake CIM/DFDS layers into de-identified pipe-delimited output files serving Commercial LG/SG, IFB, and Medicare Advantage populations. 
•	Utilized Snowflake Zero-Copy Cloning and Query Result Caching to cut processing time by 40% on incremental monthly runs, built Python-based file validation scripts to enforce layout specs across Member Roster, Demographic, Group, and Claims files, and staged output files in Azure Blob Storage prior to SFTP delivery via GlobalScape MFT. 
•	Developed a Weekly OPTUM Claims Extract pipeline for WebTPA platform (COSMOS and UNET systems) to accurately calculate 2026 Stop Loss deductibles for multiple employer groups across health plan systems, ensuring claims incurred in 2025 but paid in 2026 are captured for financial risk management and cost containment.
•	Reduced manual effort and improved data accuracy across Stop Loss financial reconciliation and WebTPA Platform Migration initiative by automating validation and delivery workflows.
•	Worked with QA team to validate transformation logic, reviewed test results, fixed mapping issues, and supported UAT and production deployment activities.
•	Maintained mapping specifications, workflow dependency docs, and release notes in JIRA and Confluence for all DataOut and WebTPA pipeline deliverables.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer / Senior ETL Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed a cloud-based medical claims data pipeline migrating On-Prem infrastructure to Snowflake for regulatory compliance reporting using IDMC, IDQ, Azure Blob and Python.
•	Created end-to-end ETL workflows in structured dependency sequence (Driver table, Claim Header and Claim Service tables (ICD Diagnosis, Payment, Provider, Remark Code), implementing version control logic and data deduplication across multiple source systems. 
•	Optimized IDMC pipeline performance through session-level tuning and parallelism configuration, reducing workflow execution time from 6 hours to 1 hour 40 minutes, achieving 72% performance improvement.
•	Worked on a Medicare government compliance project where CMS rates health insurance plans on a 1 to 5-star scale annually, lower ratings cost plans millions in lost federal bonus payments. 
•	Built a data-driven system to track whether members completed required preventive screenings, tests and medications, flagging gaps before CMS annual deadline.
•	Designed and developed dynamic, parameterized ETL pipelines in Python ingesting multi-format CSV files from 14+ heterogeneous source systems via Azure Blob Storage, applying CDC-based incremental loads into Snowflake data warehouse to eliminate full table scans and reducing processing time significantly.
•	Implemented complex SQL transformations using advanced analytical functions (partitioning, ranked deduplication) alongside Snowflake Streams to capture real-time data changes. 
•	Merged member eligibility, claims and HEDIS datasets from multiple sources with business-driven cleansing rules ensuring single source of truth across Medicare Advantage and Medicaid populations.

positions.title: Senior ETL Developer - Application Programmer V
positions.description:
•	Developed systems that collect, manage, and convert raw data into usable information for reporting and business users to interpret.
•	Designed and implemented data pipeline to process large volume of structured data by integrating 200 million records from 25+ data sources using Informatica cloud and snowflake.
•	Experienced with onshore/offshore business model for development activities.
•	Created tables, views, secured views, user defined functions in Snowflake cloud data warehouse.
•	Migrated multiple Oracle database objects to Snowflake.
•	Created testcases and relevant documents for data quality checks and migration process.
•	Developed Autosys JIL’s script to schedule job and support activities for Production environment.
•	Provided production support for Data Warehouse issues such as data load problems, transformation, Data mismatches, improve data quality, backfills and enhancements.
positions.insights: Skills: Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Data Warehousing · Snowflake · Data Engineering · Informatica · Unix · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior ETL Developer
positions.description:
• Replaced existing static Overdraft Matrix algorithm which calculated overdraft limits on monthly basis 
with a new dynamic analytically driven rules to derive the Overdraft limits on daily basis.
• Created, built, and maintained ETL efficient and effective solutions that meet the business needs
• Created complex SQL and Shell scripts to generate report files consumed by the downstream system.
• Optimize ETL workflows and Database for improved performance and scalability.
• Built data integration and analytics solutions for up-to-date and accurate data.
• Performed data analysis and profiling activity.
• Experience in monitoring and optimizing ETL performance, including database tuning, query 
optimization, and performance tuning of ETL workflows.
• Collaborated with Business Analysts, the onshore team, downstream partners, and other internal teams.
• Implemented effective data pipelines to process big datasets with batch processing system.
• Experience in troubleshooting and debugging ETL processes for efficient and effective ETL runs.
• Written data quality checks for the processed data.
• Mentored junior ETL developers, provided technical guidance, and shared best practices.
positions.insights: Skills: Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Data Warehousing · Shell Scripting · Oracle SQL Developer · Performance Tuning · Business Requirements · Data Extraction · Data Management · Informatica · Oracle Database · Query Writing · Python (Programming Language) · Data Analysis

positions.title: ETL Developer
positions.description:
Project: ETL Foremost: Zurich Insurance
• Extract data from various sources such as policy management systems, claims systems, other related 
sources, transformed by applying business rules, data cleansing, data aggregation, and data enrichment
to make it consistent and usable for reporting and analytics purposes.
• Performed incremental loading from one layer to another, as per the business requirements.
• Implemented unit testing, covered required test cases, and documented the test results in unit test plans.
• Performed performance tuning ETL processes to optimize data processing and load times.

Project: MDM Implementation: Massachusetts Financial Services
• Set up a 360-view served as a central point of access for all business users to collect and analyze 
customer data, enabling them to make informed decisions based on accurate and consistent data .
• Used IDQ tool for data cleaning process and was then used by MDM to provide the golden records.
• Implemented data cleansing activities by identifying and rectifying detected inaccurate data.
• Followed Agile (SCRUM) methodology with high quality deliverables delivered on-time.
• Troubleshooting and developing production hot fixes in case of failures
• Created and maintained technical documentation, including design documents, and ETL tools

Project: IDQ Data Checks: MFS – Financial Service
• Implemented data quality checks to cleanse various source data based on stakeholder requirements.
• Converted all the SQL checks into automated checks using IDQ (Informatica Data Quality) tool, 
in order to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of data 
• Conducted data profiling and data quality assessments to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
• Automated the data quality checks using IDQ, to provide more efficient and accurate analysis
positions.insights: Skills: informatica Data Quality · ETL Tools · Data Warehousing · Shell Scripting · Performance Tuning · Informatica · SQL · Query Writing · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: ETL Developer
positions.description:
Project: ETL Oncology S & M: Novartis – Life Science
• Populated the data from heterogonous sources including Salesforce system to a tabular structure by 
applying SCD type 2 using Informatica PowerCenter tool.
• Enhanced system performance by optimizing queries on both the source and target sides using Oracle 
indexes, hints, and partitioning techniques.

 Project: Data Analytics: Reliance JIO – Communication
• Stored large volumes of communication data in compressed format within the data vault, and 
subsequently extracted it based on dynamic parameters specified by clients.
• developed a Unix-based dynamic data extraction tool that utilized parameters specified in a file to 
fetch data from the data vault through dynamic querying.

Project: Hartford – Insurance
• Created and maintained ETL pipelines to support a range of insurance-related applications, including 
claims management, auto insurance, and personal insurance.
• Developed the bulk load algorithm by using Oracle SQL and PL/SQL functions like Stored Procedures,
functions, Triggers, Cursors and Collections
• Resolved production incidents and problems by analyzing logs, performing root cause analysis, and 
implementing appropriate solutions.
• Provided production support for critical applications, ensuring high availability and minimal downtime
positions.insights: Skills: Database Design · Data Warehousing · Shell Scripting · Autosys · PL/SQL · Informatica · SQL · Oracle Database · Query Writing · Data Analysis
